title: A commit a job makes names the operator who submitted it and the job, whichever identity authors it
goal: kg_trailers.job_trailers(environ) reads KB_JOB and KB_JOB_OPERATOR, which the executor sets for a job's process, and apply_trailers(message, computed, operator=..., job=...) sets KB-Operator to the submitter and adds KB-Job: JB-..., whatever git author the job's identity gives; an operator value that is an email address or a session GUID, or a job value that is no job id, is dropped with a line on stderr; commits made outside a job are unchanged

run:
import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,os.path.abspath("_tools")); import kg_trailers
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(["git","init","-q",d],check=True); os.chdir(d)
op,job=kg_trailers.job_trailers({"KB_JOB":"JB-abcdefgh","KB_JOB_OPERATOR":"corp/ops/jan.kowalski"})
m=kg_trailers.apply_trailers("subject\n\nbody\n",{},operator=op,job=job)
bad=kg_trailers.job_trailers({"KB_JOB":"nojob","KB_JOB_OPERATOR":"jan.kowalski@corp.example.com"})
none=kg_trailers.job_trailers({})
assert "KB-Operator: corp/ops/jan.kowalski" in m and "KB-Job: JB-abcdefgh" in m, m
assert bad==(None,None) and none==(None,None), (bad,none)

clauses.clause: kg_trailers.job_trailers(environ) reads KB_JOB and KB_JOB_OPERATOR, which the executor sets for a job's process
apply_trailers(message, computed, operator=..., job=...) sets KB-Operator to the submitter and adds KB-Job: JB-..., whatever git author the job's identity gives
an operator value that is an email address or a session GUID, or a job value that is no job id, is dropped with a line on stderr
commits made outside a job are unchanged

gates.question: What does check-trailers accept as a KB-Operator value, now that a job's submitter is an operator path such as corp/ops/jan.kowalski?
options: a single id as before, or ids joined by / up to 200 characters
a single id only, the job's operator path cut to its last segment
gates.recommendation: a single id as before, or ids joined by / up to 200 characters
gates.answer: a single id as before, or ids joined by / up to 200 characters

gates.question: How is the job audited by check-trailers, and is the wiring of the commit-msg hook and of the executor's environment part of this item?
options: KB-Job is a trailer key checked once against JB- and 8 characters; the wiring in kg_hooks.py and kj_exec.py, outside the touches, goes to a bug
no check of KB-Job; wire kg_hooks.py and kj_exec.py here
gates.recommendation: KB-Job is a trailer key checked once against JB- and 8 characters; the wiring in kg_hooks.py and kj_exec.py, outside the touches, goes to a bug
gates.answer: KB-Job is a trailer key checked once against JB- and 8 characters; wire kj_exec.py (sets KB_JOB and KB_JOB_OPERATOR for the job's process) and kg_hooks.py (commit-msg calls job_trailers) here, touches widened to both, since the goal says the executor sets them
